figurative_meaning_en: To become disheartened; to feel dejected
example_sentences_in_bangla: পরীক্ষায় খারাপ ফলাফল পেয়ে তার মন ভাঙানো হয়ে গেল।
example_sentences_in_english: After getting poor exam results, he became disheartened.
The friend's betrayal left him feeling dejected.
note: This idiom reflects emotional vulnerability common in Bengali expressive language.
